sloka: प्रीतो नाम ततो भूत्वा भृत्यानां त्वमरिन्दम।भोगांश्च परिवारांश्च कामांश्च वसु दापय ।। ६.६४.२८ ।।
transliteration: prīto nāma tato bhūtvā bhṛtyānāṁ tvamarindama।bhogāṁśca parivārāṁśca kāmāṁśca vasu dāpaya ।। 6.64.28 ।।

translations.english: "O tamer of enemies! In the name of expression of happiness, thereafter gift items of enjoyment to the attendants, and companions and granting wealth as per their desire.
